conceptZh: 兔子魔術師變出超大香蕉，扛不動，小猴子用尾巴幫忙，筆畫跟著掉下來。
object: a magician rabbit, an oversized banana and a small monkey plush
morph: a too-big conjured banana is hauled by a tiny monkey while the strokes of 猴 drop
creativeAngle: 尺寸反差：魔術變過頭，香蕉大過兔子。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip on a pale melon background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 猴 as the only text on screen, drawn in chocolate brown solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. 0-1.7s: a cartoon rabbit in a top hat yanks a banana from his hat that keeps growing until it is bigger than he is and he staggers under it; the first 猴 is spoken as the left animal radical 犭 slides in. 1.7-3.4s: the banana tips over and bonks him into the ground like a seesaw; the second 猴 is spoken as the 侯 pieces on the right drop in one by one. 3.4-5s: 小猴 is spoken as a tiny monkey plush swings in by its tail, peels the giant banana in one flick, and slides down the peel. 5-8s: hold; the monkey hangs upside down by its tail beside the glyph, and the rabbit gives a tiny bow, glyph still. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "猴、猴、小猴" (ㄏㄡˊ、ㄏㄡˊ、ㄒㄧㄠˇ ㄏㄡˊ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word; no other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Final 3 seconds (5-8s): the glyph 猴 is perfectly still and fully readable while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.

conceptZh: 豬探長舉著超大放大鏡追一條亂竄的猴子尾巴，繞圈滑倒、飛撲趴地「啪」一聲，滑痕和摔散的碎片排成猴字，結果小猴子一直坐在他的帽子上。
object: a stout cartoon detective pig in a checked deerstalker hat with an oversized magnifying glass, chasing a runaway curly monkey tail; a tiny cartoon monkey hiding on top of his hat
morph: the pig's skidding chase loops lay down the curled 犭 radical on the left, and his belly-flop SPLAT scatters the loose brown pieces that stack upright into 侯 on the right, completing 猴
creativeAngle: 改走追逐喜劇：不再是魔術師與香蕉，而是豬探長追一條會逃跑的猴尾巴，滑行痕跡畫出犭、飛撲震散碎片堆成侯，最後揭曉猴子一直坐在他帽子上，正好對上「猴子」這個詞。
promptEn:
An 8-second 2D cartoon clip on a flat pale cream background. The only text on screen is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 猴, in thick solid cobalt-blue strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with clear margins, correctly structured: the animal radical 犭 on the left, 侯 on the right. No other writing, no subtitles.

Lead: a stout cartoon detective pig in a checked deerstalker hat, carrying a magnifying glass far too big for him. He is eager, proud and clumsy. Supporting creature: a tiny brown cartoon monkey, hidden on top of his hat the whole time; only its long curly tail is visible, dangling in front of the pig's nose.

0-1.5s: The pig squints through the giant lens at a curly brown tail wiggling in front of him. He points, gasps "a clue!" with a silent gesture, and charges. The tail whips away to the right. The first 猴 is spoken as his skid marks curl across the left side of the frame and lock into the blue 犭 radical.

1.5-3.5s: The chase grows into bigger loops. The pig skids around an invisible corner, trotters spinning, trips over his own feet, and his magnifying glass bounces off his head with a soft BOINK. The tail zips between his legs. He freezes for a half-beat, wiggles his rump, then launches a huge flying leap. The second 猴 is spoken as he belly-flops with a cartoon SPLAT, squashing wide then bouncing back round; the jolt shakes loose brown pieces that tumble upright and stack into 侯 beside the 犭, completing 猴.

3.5-5s: Dazed, he grins and lifts the big lens to inspect the tail in his trotter. The tail goes taut and leads straight up to his hat. The tiny monkey pops up from the deerstalker and waves. The word 猴子 is spoken exactly at this pop-up reveal. The pig goes cross-eyed with surprise.

5-8s: Hold. The glyph 猴 stays perfectly still, centered and fully readable. Away from the strokes, the pig peers upward through the giant lens at the monkey on his hat, and the monkey pats the hat brim and swings its tail happily.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly these syllables, slowly and distinctly with clear tones: "猴、猴、猴子" (ㄏㄡˊ、ㄏㄡˊ、ㄏㄡˊ ˙ㄗ). A short pause between the two single utterances. The voice stops after the word; no other speech, no repetition, no translation. Soft cartoon sound effects only, quieter than the voice. Bright but not neon palette, no pure white blowouts, no watermark, no flashing, nothing busy in the background.
